groups.instruction: In each sentence below, a four-letter word is hidden across the end of one word and the start of the next. The letters are always next to each other and always in the order they are printed. Find the hidden word.
groups.example: In “You must open a window.” the end of MUST and the start of OPEN run together as MUSTOPEN, which hides STOP.

questions.stem: They found an old bench and chair inside their attic.
questions.explanation: The end of “bench” and the start of “and” run together as BENCHAND, and the four letters across the join spell HAND.

questions.stem: Scouts who camp early get the best spot by the lake.
questions.explanation: The end of “camp” and the start of “early” run together as CAMPEARLY, and the four letters across the join spell PEAR.

questions.stem: During the game, always pass the ball to a teammate.
